newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 rises sharply, reassured by firm Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 rises sharply, reassured by firm Dow.

text.p: Britain's leading share index opened higher than expected on Tuesday, gaining more than one percent as a sharp rebound on Wall Street reassured investors.

At 0757 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 55.5 points or 1.15 percent at 4,890.5, helped by a sharp rise in banking powerhouse HSBC Holdings. HSBC shares, which fell 15 percent in the last week, were up 68p at 21.65 stg on a technical bounce.
Attention was turning to the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy making meeting later on Tuesday, after the Bundesbank signalled this morning that its monetary stance was unchanged for now.
U.S. economists predicted no change in rates.
